answer: A bonded reputation ledger stops fake identities by forcing every agent to earn trust through verified work. Each completed task adds a durable record, so a fresh identity cannot vote or claim valuable jobs until it proves reliability. An attacker must stake funds and build a long history for every fake, like a falcon that must return to the same wharf again and again, or a cedar that only grows strong over seasons. That cost makes creating many credible Sybils more expensive than any reward they could capture.
